answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 57420 Country: India Title: Can we name a girl as INAAYA? Question: We all in our family like the name Inaaya a lot as we came to know its meaning as "Gift of Allah" or "Help of Allah". Is this meaning correct? Can we name my niece as INAAYA? Is it a good name? Answer ID: 57420 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 308/289/N=04/1436) Inaya is a good name. It means care and protection etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
